_comment: Processed from the raw Haze feat API export. isGroup=true entries are weapon/skill-choice headers (e.g. base Weapon Focus) — the individual choosable variants (e.g. Weapon Focus (bastard sword)) are separate entries in this same list with their own id and prereqs, tagged with groupId/groupName pointing back to the header. isE6Only=true feats are NOT available during normal 1-6 leveling — they unlock post-level-6 via Epic XP (see the E6 system notes) and eexpCost is what they cost in that system.

feats.name: Against the Elements (E6)
feats.description:
Type of feat: epic (available via the E6 menu)

Specifics: Your body has become familiar with the many elemental threats of Narumer.

Gain a permanent 4/- DR to all elemental damage, however you receive a -2 to your Armor Class.

Use: automatic

feats.name: Ambidexterity
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups)
Prerequisite: dexterity 15+
Required for: improved two-weapon fighting

Specifics: A character with this feat reduces the penalties suffered when fighting with two weapons. The normal penalty of -4 to the primary hand and -8 to the off-hand becomes -4 for the primary hand and -4 for the off-hand. The two-weapon fighting feat further reduces the attack penalty for both weapons by 2 (to -2/-2). Best results are achieved if the off-hand weapon is light, further reducing the penalty for both the primary and off-hand by 2 (to 0/0). 

Use: automatic

feats.name: Arcane Fist Path - Initiation
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 2, the ability to cast 1st-level arcane spells.
Specifics: An Arcane Fist Monk blends martial prowess with arcane energy, gaining the following abilities:

- Their unarmed strikes are treated as +1 weapons for the purpose of bypassing damage reduction and magical wards.
- They gain Spell Resistance (SR) equal to 7 + their Character level, as they are protected by runic wards etched into their body.

Additionally, they may activate this ability to spend 3 Ki to gain +1d4 magic damage on their currently equipped gloves for 1 turn (10 rounds).

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Arcane Fist Path - Proficiency
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 4, the ability to cast 1st-level arcane spells, arcane fist path - initiation
Specifics: An Arcane Fist Monk deepens their mastery of martial and arcane synergy, gaining the following abilities:

- Their unarmed strikes are treated as +2 weapons for the purpose of bypassing damage reduction and magical wards.
- They improve their runic wards, granting Spell Resistance (SR) equal to 11 + their Character level.

Additionally, they may activate this ability to spend 3 Ki to gain +1d4 magic damage on their currently equipped gloves for 1 turn (10 rounds).

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Arcane Trickster
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: rogue 4, intelligence 13+
Specifics: A preferred path for the prankster and the street magician, some rogues enhance their fine-honed skills of stealth and agility with basic magic.

- Grants the rogue +2 Use Magic Device.
- May cast the following spells once per day, Daze, Guidance, Minor Image and Mage Hand 3x per day, as special abilities applied to your character.
- Also gains the use of a special "Mage Hand" cantrip, which is silent & invisible. When targeting another creature with this mage-hand, you will attempt a !steal check. The hand may open doors and attempt to disable traps and locks. Activate this mage hand by activating the "Arcane Trickster" feat directly.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Arcane Weapon
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: +2 base attack bonus, ability to cast 1st-level spells, concentration 4

Specifics: You've learned to channel raw magical energy into your weapon strikes, briefly empowering your blows with arcane force.

Twice per day, as a free action, you may infuse your melee weapon with arcane power for 1 turn. While infused:

- Your weapon deals +1d4 bonus magical damage.

- The weapon is treated as a +1 magical weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction, if it is not already.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Barbarian Rage (1x per day)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Barbarian.
Specifics: The barbarian may rage, gaining a +4 morale bonus to Strength and Constitution and +2 to all Will saving throws, in exchange for a -2 penalty to Armor Class. The barbarian may use this ability once per day at first level, +1 use per day at level 4, and every 4 levels thereafter.

Additionally, While raging, a Barbarian gains DR equal to their Barbarian level, with a total absorption of 5 x Barbarian level.

- Example: A level 2 Barbarian will have DR 2/+1 and can absorb up to 10 HP in damage.

This caps out at level 5, providing 5/+1 DR with a max absorption of 25 HP. At Barbarian (6) it becomes 5/+2.

Use: Selected.

feats.name: Barbarian Rage (2x per day)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Barbarian.
Specifics: The barbarian may rage, gaining a +4 morale bonus to Strength and Constitution and +2 to all Will saving throws, in exchange for a -2 penalty to Armor Class. The barbarian may use this ability once per day at first level, +1 use per day at level 4, and every 4 levels thereafter.

Additionally, While raging, a Barbarian gains DR equal to their Barbarian level, with a total absorption of 5 x Barbarian level.

- Example: A level 2 Barbarian will have DR 2/+1 and can absorb up to 10 HP in damage.

This caps out at level 5, providing 5/+1 DR with a max absorption of 25 HP. At Barbarian (6) it becomes 5/+2.

Use: Selected.

feats.name: Barbarian Rage (Berserker Rage)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels)

Specifics: The Barbarian receives a +4l bonus to Str and Con, and -2 to AC and Attack Rolls. They gain immunity to mind-affecting spells, paralysis, level drain, and petrification abilities. On rage end, the barbarian will take 1d6 damage, and be confused for 1d6 rounds.

This feat uses the charges of "Barbarian Rage"

Use: selected.

Specifics: The Barbarian forgoes any strength or con bonus during rage, receives no AC penalty, and receives a -25% move speed debuff. They gain DR to physical, and fire/acid/electric/cold equal to your physical DR from your barbarian level.

This feat uses the charges of "Barbarian Rage"

Use: selected.

feats.name: Barbarian Rage (Mystic Rage)
feats.description:

Specifics: The Barbarian enters a magical rage. The Barbarian uses a base rage charge. When they Mystic Rage they gain 7 Spell resistance + 1 per level and 1 Magic Damage on hit for the duration of the rage for every three levels (Max of +3 damage).

Additionally, if the Barbarian has 2 or more levels of Barbarian, they receive a Damage Shield that will damage attackers while raged equal to their Barbarian Level / 2 with Magical Damage.

This feat uses the charges of "Barbarian Rage"

Use: selected.

Prerequisite: barbarian 1
Specifics: The Barbarian gains a +4 dex bonus, but forgoes their Strength, Con, and DR bonus. For the duration of the rage, they gain a +25% move speed bonus, spring attack, as well as a 1d6 sneak attack die. Cannot be stacked with Rogue sneak attacks.

This feat uses the charges of "Barbarian Rage"

Use: selected.

feats.name: Barbarian Warcry
feats.description:

Specifics: All hostile creatures within a huge radius of the Barbarian must make a Will saving throw (DC 10 + Barbarian level + the Barbarian’s Charisma modifier) or become Feared for 1d2 + 1 rounds.

Animals and Beasts take a –2 penalty on their saving throw against this effect, as their instincts make them more susceptible.

The Barbarian may use this ability a number of times per day equal to their unmodified Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

Use: selected.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Blooded

Specifics: Character gains a +2 bonus on Initiative, as well as a +2 bonus on Spot and Listen checks.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Bone-Crusher Technique
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: fighter 1, barbarian 1, discipline 4, strength 15

Specifics: You have learned to master your rage with your martial training.

While raging, any melee hit that exceeds the target AC by 5 or more, forces the target to make a fortitude save or be knocked prone.

The DC increases by 4 if the target is smaller than you, and decreases by 4 if the target is larger than you.

Use: passive.

feats.name: Breath of the Night
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 1, charisma 11+

Specifics: You can use "Fog Cloud" as the spell, centered on yourself.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Brimstone Blast
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 3, charisma 13+

Specifics: This eldritch essence invocation allows you to change your eldritch blast into a brimstone blast. A brimstone blast deals fire damage.

Any creature struck by a brimstone blast must succeed on a Reflex save or catch on fire, taking 2d6 points of fire damage per round until it takes a full-round action to extinguish the flames or the duration expires. The fire damage persists for 1 round per five class levels you have.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Bullheaded
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: only take this feat at 1st-level.
Specifics: The character gains a +2 bonus on resisting taunts and a +1 bonus on will saving throws.

Additionally, when hit with a critical hit, you will reduce the physical damage taken by 20%.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Call of the Beast
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 2, charisma 12+

Specifics: You may cast "Aspect of the Wolf" on yourself at-will.

Additionally, You gain access to the "Animal" language.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Called Shot
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: Base attack bonus of +1 or higher.
Specifics: Grants the ability to make a potentially disabling attack against an opponent's arms or legs. Called shots are made at a -2 penalty, and must overcome the target's Discipline skill check. A successful called shot against the legs reduces the opponent's movement rate by 20% and gives them a -2 to their dexterity. A successful called shot against the arms applies a cumulative -1 penalty to the creature's attack rolls.

Use: Selected.

feats.name: Charismatic Defender
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: charisma 13, dodge, fighter 1
Specifics: Your commanding presence bolsters the defenses of nearby allies. All allies within 5 meters gain a +1 shield bonus to Armor Class.

This bonus improves as your mastery of battlefield defense grows:
- +2 shield bonus if you have at least 3 Fighter levels and Charisma 15 or higher.
- +3 shield bonus if you have at least 5 Fighter levels and Charisma 17 or higher.

An ally may benefit from only one instance of Charismatic Defender at a time. Multiple characters possessing this feat do not grant cumulative bonuses.

Use: passive

feats.name: Chilling Tentacles
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 4, charisma 14+
Specifics: You can create a field of chilling tentacles that will damage those who enter, and have a chance to slow them as well.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Chirurgeon
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General (available every 3 level ups)
Prerequisite: Commoner 1, 6 heal ranks, Clinical Mind, Combat Medic
Specifics: You can use a needle and thread to stabilize a creature in or out of combat, with no chance to damage them. Players you successfully target with a needle and thread to stabilize are immune to a blood vessel rupture for five rounds.

((Roleplay bonus - when a target is afflicted with a permanent injury, you may with DM assistance perform a surgery, consuming a T3 or higher level healing kit to make a DC 30 heal check to shift the effect from the 'Pre-Treatment Effect' to 'Post-Treatment Effect' as indicated on the Permanent Injuries table on the wiki.))

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Chirurgeon's Resourcefulness
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General (available every 3 level ups)
Prerequisite: Commoner 3, 6 heal ranks, 4 concentration ranks, Clinical Confidence, Chirurgeon
Specifics: When attempting a heal check using bandages or kits, you have a chance to not consume bandages equal to 5% per commoner level you have, when wearing no or light armor.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Circle Kick
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups)
Prerequisite: monk 3, 6 ranks acrobatics, improved unarmed strike

Specifics: If the character succeeds in hitting an opponent with an unarmed attack, that character gets an additional free attack against another, nearby enemy. There is a maximum of one free attack per round.

Use: automatic

Specifics: If the character kills an opponent, he gets a free attack against any opponent who is within melee weapon range.
Use: Automatic.

Use: Automatic.

Specifics: When attempting a heal check, you roll twice (for the d20 check) and take the larger result to determine the effect when wearing no or light armor. 

Additionally, Your heal bonus with Clinical Pragmatism is improved (and replaced) so that a successful heal check using bandages or kits restores three extra hit points, plus an additional hit point per commoner level, when wearing no or light armor. 

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Clinical Mind

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Clinical Pragmatism
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General (available every 3 level ups)
Prerequisite: Commoner 2, 5 heal ranks, 2 concentration ranks, Clinical Confidence
Specifics: Your successful heal checks using bandages or kits restores two extra hit points, plus an additional hit point per two commoner levels, when wearing no or light armor. 

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Cold Comfort
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 4, charisma 14+

Specifics: You may cast "Protection from Elements" on yourself at-will.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Combat Casting
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Ability to cast 1st-level spells.
Required for: Improved Combat Casting.
Specifics: The character is adept at casting spells in combat, and does not suffer the standard -4 penalty to Concentration checks when casting defensively within four meters of an enemy.

Additionally, characters with this feat gain a +1 bonus to touch attacks from spells, as if they had a weapon focus (spells) feat.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Combat Medic
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General (available every 3 level ups)
Prerequisite: 6 heal ranks
Specifics: This feat grants a +2 insight bonus to heal checks.

Additionally, you do not need to succeed a concentration check to stabilize someone with an enemy nearby.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Commander's Rally
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: charisma 15, fighter 1

Specifics: You have trained to be a commander, two times per day, you can do a rallying cry to the soldiers around you, inspiring them in the fight.

While rallied, those within 10m of you, gain immunity to fear, and +2 bonus to all saving throws for 1 turn. If already feared, the fear will be removed.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Courteous Magocracy
feats.description:
Type of feat: General (available every three level-ups)
Prerequisite: Can only take this feat at first level.

Specifics: The character gains a +2 bonus on Knowledge: General checks and Spellcraft checks.

Use: automatic

feats.name: Craft Focus (Alchemy)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: intelligence 12+, wisdom 12+
Specifics: You have specialized at a craft or trade so well, you receive a +2 Effective Craft Level (ECL) bonus to that craft.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Craft Focus (Blacksmithing)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: intelligence 12+, wisdom 12+
Specifics: You have specialized at a craft or trade so well, you receive a +2 Effective Craft Level (ECL) bonus to that craft.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Craft Focus (Cooking)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: intelligence 12+, wisdom 12+
Specifics: You have specialized at a craft or trade so well, you receive a +2 Effective Craft Level (ECL) bonus to that craft.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Craft Focus (Leatherworking)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: intelligence 12+, wisdom 12+
Specifics: You have specialized at a craft or trade so well, you receive a +2 Effective Craft Level (ECL) bonus to that craft.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Craft Focus (Tinkering)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: intelligence 12+, wisdom 12+
Specifics: You have specialized at a craft or trade so well, you receive a +2 Effective Craft Level (ECL) bonus to that craft.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Craft Focus (Woodcrafting)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: intelligence 12+, wisdom 12+
Specifics: You have specialized at a craft or trade so well, you receive a +2 Effective Craft Level (ECL) bonus to that craft.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Crippling Strike
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Rogue level 4.
Specifics: The rogue deals an additional 2 points of ability score Strength damage when they make a successful sneak attack.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Crossbow Sniper
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: weapon focus (heavy crossbow) or weapon focus (light crossbow), 13 intelligence, sneak attack, Base attack bonus of +1 or higher.

Specifics: A character with this feat is deadly when using their sneak attack combined with a crossbow, the range they are able to land a critical hit is doubled from 10 meters to 20 meters.

Use: passive.

feats.name: Crystallised (E6)
feats.description:
Type of feat: epic (available via the E6 menu)

Specifics: Your body is hardened against harsh cold, at a cost.

You gain 5/- DR to all cold damage, but gain a permanent vulnerability of 30% to all fire damage.

Use: automatic

feats.name: Curse Song
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: -
Specifics: Bards are able to sing a song that can curse their enemies. Deafened creatures are not affected by the bard's singing. The song affects all enemies within 30 feet and lasts for 10 rounds. The higher the bard's final Perform skill and class level, the more powerful the Curse song. All of the penalties listed are additive.
3 Perform and Bard Level 1: -1 to Attack and Damage rolls.
6 Perform and Bard Level 2: -1 to Will Saves.
9 Perform and Bard Level 3: -1 to Damage rolls and -1 to Fortitude Saves.
12 Perform and Bard Level 6: -1 to Reflex saves, -1 to Skill rolls.
15 Perform and Bard Level 8: -1 to Attack rolls, 8 damage.
18 Perform and Bard Level 11: -2 to Dodge Armor Class, -1 to Skill rolls.
Perform 21 and Bard Level 14: -1 to Damage rolls, 8 damage and -1 Dodge Armor Class.
Perform 24 and Bard Level 15: -1 Will Saves, -1 Reflex Saves, -1 Fortitude Saves, -1 Dodge Armor Class.
Perform 25 and Bard Level 16: -1 Will Saves, 4 damage. -1 Dodge Armor Class.
For each additional 5 Perform and 1 Class level in Bard an additional 2 damage is granted.
Use: Selected.

feats.name: Dagger Specialist
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: rogue 4
Specifics: +1 to attack rolls when using daggers, and adds half their base dexterity modifier to damage with them. The rogue has honed their skills with daggers, making them more effective with this weapon.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Damage Reduction 1
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Barbarian level 11.
Specifics: This feat allows the barbarian to shrug off one point of damage from each attack that causes them damage.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Damage Reduction 2
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Barbarian level 14.
Specifics: This feat allows barbarians to shrug off two points of damage from each attack that hits them.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Darkness
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 2, charisma 12+

Specifics: You can use "Darkness" as the spell, centered on yourself.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Dead Walk
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 4, charisma 14+

Specifics: You gain access to the "Animate Dead" spell at-will.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Defensive Roll
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Rogue level 4.
Specifics: If the rogue is struck by a potentially lethal blow, they make a Reflex saving throw (DC = damage dealt). If succesful, they take only half damage from the blow.
Use: Automatic, but limited to one use per day. Flat-footed characters cannot make a defensive roll.

feats.name: Defensive Stance
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: 13 int, BAB +3, dodge, toughness

Specifics: In this defensive stance, a defender gains phenomenal durability, but they cannot move from the spot they are defending. They gain a +4 dodge bonus on AC.

This ability can be used 2/day.

Use: combat mode

feats.name: Defensive Training vs Humans
feats.description:
Type of feat: race
Prerequisite: half-orc, orc

Specifics: This feat grants a +1 dodge bonus to AC against all humans.

Use: automatic

feats.name: Deflect Arrows
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Dex 13+, Improved Unarmed Strike.
Specifics: The character can attempt to deflect one incoming missile attack per round. This is treated as a Reflex save made against DC 20.
Use: Automatic if not caught flat-footed. Monks receive this feat for free at level 2.

feats.name: Devil's Sight
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 2, charisma 12+

Specifics: You gain the visual acuity of a devil. Granting you ultravision permanently.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Dirty Fighting
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Base attack bonus +2.
Specifics: The character knows brutal and effective fighting tactics. By sacrificing all other attacks during the round, the character can elect to perform a dirty fighting move that will deal an extra 1d4 points of damage. This mode cannot be used with power attack.
Use: Combat Mode.

feats.name: Disarm
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: Int 13+.
Required for: Improved Disarm.
Specifics: The character can attempt to disarm an opponent in melee combat. Attempting a disarm applies a -2 penalty to the character's attack roll. A successful hit deals normal damage, and if the opponent fails a Discipline check then the weapon flies from the opponent's hands.

Use: Selected. A disarm attempt provokes an attack of opportunity.

feats.name: Dissonant Chord
feats.description:
Type of feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: bard, curse song

Specifics: A discordant melody disrupting the concentration of enemy spellcasters. Enemies within a huge area of the Bard playing a Dissonant Chord suffers Spell Failure as well as a penalty to their concentration checks. 10% Spell Failure and -1 to their checks for each 3 modified Perform ranks (To a maximum of 50% and -5).

Use: selected.

feats.name: Divine Bolt
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: Pure cleric, may only be selected at level 3, requires destruction, knowledge, magic, moon or sun domain.
Specifics: While unarmored or wearing light armor and no shield, you can expend 2 charges of Turn Undead to launch a bolt of divine light at a creature. If you succeed on a ranged touch attack, the bolt deals 1d6 divine damage + 1/2 charisma mod + 1/2 dexterity mod for a maximum of 12 damage. 

Use: Selected.

feats.name: Divine Bond
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (granted based on class levels)
Prerequisite: paladin 6

Specifics: The Paladin may, once per day, summon a divine bond, calling forth a spirit to fight by their side. This spirit is one who has chosen to aid the Paladin due to their actions in life—individuals the Paladin has aided, loved, or inspired through acts of courage, compassion, or virtue. The summoned spirit defends the Paladin and assists in their moment of need.  The summon will remain for 1 turn (10 rounds) per paladin level.

This ability is not to be used frivolously, as the spirit’s presence is tied to the Paladin’s need for righteous intervention. Misuse may cause the spirit to feel exploited, risking their willingness to respond in the future.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Divine Conduit I
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: cleric 1
Specifics: You gain an additional cantrip spell slot.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Divine Conduit II
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: cleric 2, divine conduit I
Specifics: You gain an additional cantrip spell slot.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Divine Conduit III
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: cleric 3, divine conduit II
Specifics: You gain an additional 1st-level spell slot.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Divine Grace
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin level 1.
Specifics: The paladin adds their Charisma bonus (if positive) to all saving throws.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Divine Health
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin level 1.
Specifics: The paladin is immune to disease.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Divine Rebuke
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: can only take this feat as pure cleric 1st-level
Specifics: You can expend 2 charges of Turn Undead to deal 1 + Charisma modifier (max 7) divine damage to all enemies in range.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Divine Surge (E6)
feats.description:
Type of feat: epic (available via the E6 menu)
Prerequisite: Cleric 5
Specifics: You gain 1 extra level 3 cleric spell slot.

Use: automatic

feats.name: Divine Vigor
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: can only take this feat as pure cleric 1st-level
Specifics: You gain a +1 bonus on all attack rolls made.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Doctrine of Chivalry
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: Paladin
Specifics: These are doctrine specific paths that allow a Paladin to decide what their purpose will be.

Use: Varies.

feats.name: Doctrine of Chivalry - Aura of Gallantry
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin 3, 6 influence, Mark of Judgement
Specifics: Allies within 5m of the Paladin gain a +1 to all attack rolls.

Use: Automatic

feats_all.name: Doctrine of Chivalry - Mark of Judgement

feats.name: Doctrine of Chivalry - Mark of Judgement
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin 1, 4 influence
Specifics: Lets you use a turn charge to mark a specific enemy for judgement, all your attacks against that enemy will get a bonus equal to your charisma modifier for 1 turn.

Use: Selected

feats.name: Doctrine of Chivalry - Unyielding Defender
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin 5, Aura of Gallantry, 8 influence, pure paladin only
Specifics: Once per day, if knocked below 0hp you will heal 1d8+CHA modifier in damage.

Use: Automatic

feats_all.name: Doctrine of Chivalry - Aura of Gallantry

feats.name: Doctrine of Knowledge
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: Paladin
Specifics: These are doctrine specific paths that allow a Paladin to decide what their purpose will be.

Use: Varies.

feats.name: Doctrine of Knowledge - Divine Enlightenment
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin 3, 6 knowledge: general, Lore of the Faithful
Specifics: You may expend 2 turn charges to gain true seeing & immunity to mind affecting spells for 1 turn.

Use: Selected

feats_all.name: Doctrine of Knowledge - Lore of the Faithful

feats.name: Doctrine of Knowledge - Lore of the Faithful
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin 1, 4 knowledge: general, 13 charisma, turn undead
Specifics: You can add your CHA modifier to all knowledge skills.

Additionally, the character may spend one of his turn undead attempts to add 1/2 the paladin’s level + the paladin’s charisma modifier to spot checks for one turn + 1 round per two paladin levels. A paladin of level 4 or higher may also see invisibility while this ability is active.

Any paladin with this has the effects of Ultravision applied at all times.

Use: Selected

feats.name: Doctrine of Knowledge - Unraveling Smite
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin 5, 8 knowledge: general, Divine Enlightenment, pure paladin only
Specifics: You may expend 2 charges of turn undead, to apply a +1 Enhancement Bonus & On-hit: Dispel Magic to your melee weapon for 1 turn.

Use: Selected

feats.name: Doctrine of Nature
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: Paladin
Specifics: These are doctrine specific paths that allow a Paladin to decide what their purpose will be.

Use: Varies.

feats.name: Doctrine of Nature - Smite Abomination
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin 5, 8 knowledge: nature, Thorned Aegis, pure paladin only
Specifics: You may spend 2 turn undead charges adding an additional +1d6 divine & +1d6 acid damage to your equipped melee weapon against the unnatural (undead, abberations, and constructs) for 1 turn.

Use: Selected

feats.name: Doctrine of Nature - Thorned Aegis
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin 3, 6 knowledge: nature, Warden's Bennediction
Specifics: You may spend 1 turn undead charge to gain a damage shield of 1d4+1 piercing damage for 1 turn.

Use: Selected

feats.name: Doctrine of Nature - Warden's Benediction
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin 1, 4 knowledge: nature
Specifics: You can add your CHA modifier to Survival & Knowledge: Nature.

Additionally, you can use 1 turn charge to cast Summon Creature I

Use: Selected

feats.name: Doctrine of Rejuvenation
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: Paladin
Specifics: These are doctrine specific paths that allow a Paladin to decide what their purpose will be.

Use: Varies.

feats.name: Doctrine of Rejuvenation - Aura of Renewal
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin 5, Remove Disease, pure paladin only
Specifics: Allies within 5m of you regain 1hp every minute, this does not affect the Paladin.

Use: Automatic

feats.name: Doctrine of Rejuvenation - Lay on Hands
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin level 1.
Specifics: With this feat, characters can heal damage equal their charisma modifier. This ability consumes 1 charge of "Turn Undead" on use.

Use: Selected. When used against undead creatures, it is treated as a touch attack spell that delivers damage instead of healing.

feats.name: Doctrine of Rejuvenation - Remove Disease
feats.description:
Type of feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin level 3, Lay on Hands
Specifics: A character with this feat may remove disease using 1 turn undead charge. 

Use: Selected.

feats_all.name: Doctrine of Rejuvenation - Lay on Hands

feats.name: Doctrine of Righteousness
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: Paladin
Specifics: These are doctrine specific paths that allow a Paladin to decide what their purpose will be.

Use: Varies.

feats.name: Doctrine of Righteousness - Aura of Righteousness
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Paladin 5, 8 discipline, Divine Shield, pure paladin only
Specifics: Lets you use 2 turn charges to create an 5m radius aura around you for 1 turn, enemy creatures within the aura will take 1 damage per round, additionally, evil creatures will take 1d6 divine damage per round.

Use: Selected

feats.name: Doctrine of Righteousness - Divine Might
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups)
Prerequisite: turn undead, charisma 13+, strength 13+, paladin 1, 4 discipline

Specifics: The character may spend one of his turn undead attempts to add his charisma bonus to all weapon damage for a number of rounds equal to the charisma bonus + 3 rounds.

Use: selected

feats.name: Doctrine of Righteousness - Divine Shield
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups)
Prerequisite: turn undead, charisma 13+, strength 13+, paladin 3, divine might, 6 discipline

Specifics: The character may spend one of his turn undead attempts to add his charisma bonus to his armor class for a number of rounds equal to the charisma bonus + 3 rounds.

Use: selected

feats.name: Dodge
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Dex 13+.
Required for: Mobility and Spring Attack.
Specifics: The character gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks from his current target or last attacker.
Use: Automatic, though a condition that negates a Dexterity bonus to AC also negates any dodge bonuses. Multiple dodge bonuses (different feats, racial bonuses) are cumulative.

feats.name: Drunken Master Path - Initiation
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 2
Specifics: The monk achieves unmatched skill with improvised weapons, transforming everyday objects into deadly tools. Improvised weapons are treated as weapons under the Weapon Proficiency (Monk) feature. Additionally, the monk is treated as if they have Weapon Focus (improvised weapons), and Weapon Specialization (improvised weapons) while they are not wearing armor.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Drunken Master Path - Mastery
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 6, drunken master path - proficiency
Specifics: The monk embodies drunken, erratic, and unpredictable movements, confounding their foes with seemingly chaotic actions. Upon drinking an alcoholic beverage, the monk gains a bonus to AC equal to their Constitution modifier (min 1) for 1 turn (10 rounds).

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Drunken Master Path - Proficiency
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 4, drunken master path - initiation
Specifics: The monk channels the reckless courage of a drunken stupor, shrugging off the pain of attacks with sheer determination. By spending 1 point of Ki, the monk gains temporary hit points equal to their Monk level + 2. These temporary hit points last for 1 turn (10 rounds).

Use: selected.

feats.name: Dryad's Ditty
feats.description:
Type of feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: bard

Specifics: A short musical composition often sang by woodland creatures to cure minor ailments and heal superficial wounds. The bard heals all nearby creatures for 1 points of damage +1 per each 7 modified Perform ranks (to a maximum of +2)

Additionally, if the bard using the song knows Sylvan, grants 4 temporary hit points to all non-enemy creatures within the area.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Duelist
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups)
Prerequisite: Dex 13+, Int 13+, Armor Proficiency (light)
Specifics: Allows you to use your intelligence modifier in addition to your dexterity modifier for AC if using light armor, a rapier, scimitar, dagger or shortsword, and nothing in your offhand (including shields or weapons). To a maximum of your level.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Eavesdropper
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: rogue 4, wisdom 13+
Specifics: Can hear whispers at a much further minimum range, reducing the check to hear them even further.

Additionally, you gain a bonus to your listen skill equal to your rogue levels.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Echoes of the First Verse (E6)
feats.description:
Type of feat: epic (available via the E6 menu)
Prerequisite: Bard 3
Specifics: You gain 1 extra level 1 bard spell slot.

Use: automatic

feats.name: Eldritch Blast
feats.description:
Type of feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: warlock 1

Specifics: As an attack action, a Warlock may fire a blast of magic at his foes. This has a range of Medium (20m), and it is a ranged touch attack that affects a single target, allowing no saving throw. An eldritch blast deals 1d6 points of damage at 1st level and increases in power as the warlock rises in level, increasing by 1d6 for every 2 levels after 1st.

An eldritch blast is subject to spell resistance, although the Spell Penetration feat and other effects that improve caster level checks to overcome spell resistance also apply to eldritch blast.

A warlock can use eldritch blast at will.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Eldritch Chain
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 4, charisma 14+

Specifics: This eldritch essence invocation improves your eldritch blast by turning it into an arc of energy that "jumps" from the first target to others. An eldritch chain can jump to one secondary targets within 30 feet of the first target, allowing you to make additional ranged touch attacks and deal damage to the secondary target if you hit.

The damage of the secondary blast of energy is half that was delivered to the primary target.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Eldritch Grace
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 3, charisma 13+
Specifics: Allows you to use your charisma modifier in addition to your dexterity modifier for AC if using light or medium armor (does not work with clothing). To a maximum of your level.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Eldritch Line
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 4, charisma 14+
Specifics: Allows you to cast your Eldritch Blast as a line attack, damaging anyone within a 20meter line between you and the target.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Elemental Ward
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: water genasi
Specifics: The Water Genasi gains a +1 natural armor bonus when they are standing in the rain. This represents a protective layer formed by their affinity with water.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Elidion's Four Seasons
feats.description:
Type of feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: bard

Specifics: A melodious piece meant to be played with subtle variations depending on the season in which it is performed, from the cold embrace of midwinter, the promises and hopes of spring, the dry heat of summer and the morose rains of autumn.

- Winter: Grants resistance 5/- to cold, +2 Survival and +2 cold damage
- Spring: Grants +1 temporary hit points for each 3 modified Perform rank (Maximum of +5). Additionally grants allies +4 to fortitude saving throws versus poisons and diseases.
- Summer: Grants 5% DI to fire for each 4 modified Perform ranks (To a maximum of 20%), and the effect of the Bless spell.
- Autumn: Grants  +1 AC for each 4 modified Perform ranks versus undead (To a maximum of +4), and +4 to saving throws versus death and negative energy effects.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Empower Spell
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Metamagic
Prerequisite: Ability to cast 1st-level spells.
Specifics: All variable, numeric effects of an empowered spell are increased by 50%. For example, an empowered magic missile deals one and one-half times normal damage (1d4 + 1 multiplied by 1.5). Empowerment does not increase spell duration.
Use: An empowered spell occupies a spell slot one level higher than normal. Saving throws and opposed rolls, such as those made when Dispel Magic is cast, are not affected.

feats.name: Enchant Arrow
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: +1 bab, ability to cast 1st-level spells, AND one of the following ability scores:

- Intelligence 15 or higher, OR
- Charisma 15 or higher, OR
- Wisdom 15 or higher & Primevale Bond

Specifics: With this feat, every arrow the archer nocks and lets fly gets a +1 enhancement bonus.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Enchant Arrow (Charisma Variant)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: +1 bab, ability to cast 1st-level spells, AND one of the following ability scores:

- Intelligence 15 or higher, OR
- Charisma 15 or higher, OR
- Wisdom 15 or higher & Primevale Bond

Specifics: With this feat, every arrow the archer nocks and lets fly gets a +1 enhancement bonus.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Enchant Arrow (Ranger Variant)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: +1 bab, ability to cast 1st-level spells, AND one of the following ability scores:

- Intelligence 15 or higher, OR
- Charisma 15 or higher, OR
- Wisdom 15 or higher & Primevale Bond

Specifics: With this feat, every arrow the archer nocks and lets fly gets a +1 enhancement bonus.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Entropic Warding
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 2, charisma 12+

Specifics: You gain a permanent 20% concealment to attacks.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Epic Character
feats.description: Your training and arduous ordeals have finally brought you to the threshold that divides the realms of mortal from those of the divine. You are an epic character, capable of choosing legendary feats and raising your skills to god-like levels. Please refer to your epic class feat(s) for specific information on class benefits derived from becoming an epic character.

feats.name: Eschew Materials
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups)
Prerequisite: Wizard 1

Specifics: When you cast a cantrip from your wizard spell slots, you can ignore all material component costs in your attempt to regain the spell slot. 

Use: automatic

feats.name: Evasive Maneuver
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: rogue 4, dexterity 15+
Specifics: 3 times per day, gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC for a number of rounds equal to your intelligence modifier.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Expert Innovator
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: 15+ intelligence
Specifics: Character is able to add your class levels to their eureka rolls when trying to learn a new recipe.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Expertise
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Int 13+, Base Attack Bonus +1.
Required for: Improved Expertise
Specifics: A character with this feat can make defensive attacks, gaining a +2 bonus to AC but receiving a -10 penalty to attack rolls.

Use: Combat Mode.

feats.name: Extend Rage
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: Barbarian Rage
Specifics: This allows Barbarian Rage abilities to last an additional 5 rounds. (Does not include Warcry)

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Extend Spell
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Metamagic
Prerequisite: Ability to cast 0-level spells.
Specifics: Extended spells have their duration doubled, lasting twice as long as normal.
Use: An extended spell occupies a spell slot of the same level as normal.

feats.name: Extra Ki
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General (available every 3 level ups)
Prerequisite: wisdom 15, monk 1

Specifics: This ability allows the character to have easier time meditating, mastering the core of his path to tap into the mystical KI four times per day.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Extra Music
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Bard Song.
Specifics: The character may use bard song four extra times per day.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Extra Rage
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: Barbarian Rage
Specifics: This ability allows the character to enter Barbarian Rage two additional times per day.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Extra Smiting
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Smite Evil or Smite Good.
Specifics: This feat increases the smiting ability to 3 times per day.
Use: Selected

feats.name: Extra Turning
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Special
Prerequisite: Exclusive to clerics and paladins.
Specifics: This divine ability allows the character to turn undead four additional times per day.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Faith Healing
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: can only take this feat as pure cleric 1st-level
Specifics: The character's conjuration healing spells are more powerful to members of an aligned faith. The character adds 2 points per spell level to the amount of damage healed by any Conjuration healing spell that he casts on a member of the same faith. For example, a Cure Light Wounds spell cast by a cleric would heal 2 extra hit points, and a Cure Moderate Wounds spell would heal 4 extra hit points per target.

(( Until the Piety system is fully implemented it is based on alignment, Good/Neutral/Evil ))

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Faith be Our Shield
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: can only take this feat as pure cleric 2nd-level, requires healing, protection, beauty, strength, or creation domains
Specifics: When wearing medium armor (or less) and no shield, you may expend three uses of turn undead to grant all allies within range temporary hit points equal to your charisma bonus. This lasts for 1 turn per cleric level.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: False Faith
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: can only take this feat as pure cleric 2nd-level, requires trickery, illusion, or chaos domain
Specifics: Your deity does not spurn you for pretending to be a Cleric of another power, and in fact helps you keep up the ruse. You add your Cleric levels to your influence score and will never get in trouble with your deity for lying about your loyalties.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Favored Enemy
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Ranger or Harper level 1.
Specifics: The character gains a +1 bonus to any damage delivered to their favored enemy. They also receive a +1 bonus on Listen, Spot, and Taunt checks against the favored enemy. These bonuses improve by +1 for every 5 levels that the ranger gains, but they do not improve for the harper.
Use: Automatic. The ranger may choose additional favored enemies every 5 levels. A harper chooses one more at level 4.

feats.name: Favored Enemy: Aberrations
feats.description:
Type of feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: ranger, can only take this at first level.

Specifics: The character gains a +1 bonus to any damage delivered to his favored enemy. He also receives a +1 bonus on listen, spot, and taunt checks against the favored enemy. These bonuses improve by +1 for every 5 levels that the ranger gains, but they do not improve for the Harper.

Additionally, the character gains a +1 AC bonus against the favored enemy, and a +1 AB bonus against the favored enemy. These bonuses do not improve like the damage bonus.

feats.name: Fearless
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Race
Prerequisite: Halfling.
Specifics: This feat grants a +2 bonus on saving throws against fear spells and effects.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Fey Touched (E6)
feats.description:
Type of feat: epic (available via the E6 menu)

Specifics: For some inexplicable reason, you have become luminescent.

You gain light cast on yourself permanently.

Use: automatic

feats.name: Flurry of Blows
feats.description:
Type of feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: monk 1

Specifics: Monks receive an extra attack per round when fighting with unarmed attacks, kamas, daggers, kukri, quarterstaff, sai, nunchaku, sap, katar, claws, or wind fire wheel. However, all attacks in that round suffer a -2 attack penalty.

Use: combat mode

feats.name: Forged in Fire (E6)
feats.description:
Type of feat: epic (available via the E6 menu)

Specifics: Your body is hardened against scalding heat, at a cost.

You gain 5/- DR to all fire damage, but gain a permanent vulnerability of 30% to all cold damage.

Use: automatic

feats.name: Formally Trained
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: Int 13+, Improved Parry, 6+ ranks parry
Specifics: The enemy no longer needs to meet or beat your AC in order for you to make a Parry roll.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Frightful Blast
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 2, charisma 12+

Specifics: This eldritch invocation allows you to change your eldritch blast into a frightful blast. Any creature struck by a frightful blast must succeed on a Will save or receive -2 Attack Bonus, -2 Armor Class, and 20% Spell Failure for 1 minute. Creatures with immunity to mind-affecting spells and abilities or fear effects cannot be affected by a frightful blast.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Good Aim
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Race
Prerequisite: Halfling.
Specifics: This feat grants a +1 attack bonus on attacks made with throwing weapons.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Gospel of Stone
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: Pure cleric, may only be selected at level 3, requires creation, earth, travel, or magic domain.
Specifics: You can expend 1 charge of Turn Undead to animated earth and stone underneath a creature, entangling them for a number of rounds equal to your base charisma modifier, with a reflex save of 10 + half cleric levels (rounded down) + charisma modifier to save to avoid the effect. 

Use: Selected.

feats.name: Gospel of Thunder
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: can only take this feat as pure cleric 3rd-level, requires storm, air, or destruction domains
Specifics: You can expend a charge of Turn Undead to add 1d4 lightning damage to your weapon for 1 Turn per Cleric Level. All enemies within close range must make a DC 10+CHA Modifier Fortitude Check or be knocked prone for 1 round.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Gospel of the Blades
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: can only take this feat as pure cleric 3rd-level, requires protection, strength, or war domain
Specifics: You can expend a charge of Turn Undead to add +1 AB and +1 divine damage to yourself and your nearest non-enemy, lasting 1 turn. This increases to +2 at level 6.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Gospel of the Wayward
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: can only take this feat as pure cleric 3rd-level, requires travel, hunt, water, or storm domains
Specifics: You can expend a charge of Turn Undead to increase the speed of all allies by 20% while giving them +1 to their Saving Throws for 1 turn per Cleric level. This bonus increases to 30% and +2 when reaching level 5 of cleric.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Great Cleave
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Str 13+, Power Attack, Cleave, base attack bonus +4 or higher.
Specifics: As cleave, except that there is no limit to the number of additional attacks that the character may make after killing one opponent.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Great Fortitude
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: None.
Specifics: A character with this feat is tougher than normal, gaining a +2 bonus to all Fortitude saving throws.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Greater Spell Focus
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Spell Focus.
Specifics: A character becomes even more adept with spells of a particular school of magic. The character gains a +4 bonus to the spell save DC for all spells of the chosen school.
Use: Automatic. This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not stack. It applies to a different school of magic in each case.

feats.name: Greater Spell Focus (Abjuration)
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: Spell Focus.
Specifics: A character becomes even more adept with spells of a particular school of magic. The character gains a +4 bonus to the spell save DC for all spells of the chosen school.

Additionally, you gain an additional +1 to spellcraft checks for this spell school for interactions with the HAZE spellcraft system, making the total bonus for spell focus, and greater spell focus +2.

Use: Automatic. This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not stack. It applies to a different school of magic in each case.

Specifics: Character Gains a +2 bonus on Knowledge: Nature and Survival checks.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Gwaerim's Glee
feats.description:
Type of feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: bard

Specifics: A flowing composition reminiscent of the wind scaling northern spires and rolling down lush valleys. Whistling off the beaten path fiddle in hand, the wanderer’s tune can be heard across Narumer. Grants friendly targets a temporary bonus to movement speed of 5% for each 3 modified Perform Ranks.

Additionally, if the bard is holding a violin while playing, the duration is doubled.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Hale Vitality (E6)
feats.description:
Type of feat: epic (available via the E6 menu)

Specifics: You have become in tune with the inner workings of your body, giving you impeccable fortitude against poisons.

You gain immunity to all poison effects

Use: automatic

feats.name: Halfling Warslinger
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups)
Prerequisite: Halfling, Str 13+, Dex 13+, BAB +1
Specifics: Slings you wield gain the 'Mighty +4' modifier.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Hardiness
feats.description:
Type of feat: race

Specifics: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus to all saving throws.

Use: automatic

feats.name: Hardiness vs. Enchantments
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Race
Prerequisite: Elf or half-elf.
Specifics: This feat grants a +2 bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Hardiness vs. Illusions
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Race
Prerequisite: Gnome.
Specifics: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Hardiness vs. Poisons
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Race

Specifics: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus on saving throws vs. poison.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Hardiness vs. Spells
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Race

Specifics: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus on saving throws vs. spells.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Hearthtree
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Druid 5
Specifics: The druid may plant a single enchanted seed, an act that can only be performed once in their lifetime. Within days, the seed grows into a tree infused with the druid’s essence, permanently binding them to its roots. Thereafter, once per day, the druid may call upon the Hearthtree to return instantly to its side, regardless of distance or terrain (but not across planes unless the DM rules otherwise). If the Hearthtree is ever destroyed, the druid will be considered fallen, until such time as they are able to repair relations with nature.
Use: Selected
Special: The first time using this ability is to plant the seed, once the seed has been planted, any subsequent uses will begin a 1 minute casting to return you to the Hearthree.

feats.name: Hellfire Scion
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: warlock 1, sorcerer 1, charisma 15

Specifics: When you cast eldritch blast, you will deal extra damage based on how much essence you have stored in your sorcerer essence reserves.

Additional damage is calculated by essence in the reserves divided by 2, max +5 damage to your eldritch blast.

Use: passive.

feats.name: Hellrime Blast
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 3, charisma 13+

Specifics: This eldritch essence invocation allows you to change your eldritch blast into a hellrime blast. A hellrime blast deals cold damage. 

Any creature struck by the attack must make a Fortitude save or take a –4 penalty to Dexterity for 10 minutes. The Dexterity penalties from multiple hellrime blasts do not stack.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Heroic Figure
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: charisma 17, base attack bonus +3, fighter 1

Specifics:
You radiate confidence and gallantry. Three times per day, you may inspire all allies within 10 meters as a free action. They gain temporary HP equal to your Charisma modifier + 2 for 3 rounds.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Hideous Blow
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 1, charisma 11+

Specifics: This eldritch invocation allows you to channel your Eldritch Blast into your melee weapon for your next attack (1 round), on-hit with your melee weapon it will have the additional damage from your eldritch blast applied to the hit.

This does not take into account any additional bonuses you have for your Eldritch Blast, including, but not limited to: Agonizing Blast, Beshadowed Blast, Brimstone Blast, Hellrime Blast

Additionally, this is cast instantly, without needing an action.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Hunter
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: 2 ranks survival
Specifics: The character is trained in the hunting of various creatures, you receive a +2 circumstance bonus to any skill roll to harvest parts from a creature. 

You will also have a higher chance of finding pieces of the creature in a useable condition when using a harvesting knife.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Improved Combat Casting
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Spell
Prerequisite: Combat Casting, Concentration 6+ ranks.
Specifics: The character does not incur attacks of opportunity for casting spells while threatened.

Additionally, characters with this feat gain an additional +1 bonus to touch attacks from spells, as if they had a weapon focus (spells) feat.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Improved Disarm
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: Int 13+, Disarm.
Specifics: A character with this feat has learned not to provoke an attack of opportunity when attempting a disarm. Success knocks the opponent's weapon from his hands. The penalty to make a disarm attempt is reduced to 0.

Use: Selected.

feats.name: Improved Expertise
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Int 13+, Expertise, Base Attack Bonus +3.
Specifics: A character with this feat can make defensive attacks, gaining a +2 bonus to AC but receiving a -5 penalty to attack rolls.

Use: Combat Mode.

feats.name: Improved Familiar
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: wizard 3 (automatically granted to sorcerers at level 1)
Specifics: This feat is the result of a binding ritual that significantly strengthens the bond between an arcanist and their familiar. Through this enhanced connection, the familiar is now considered one level lower than its master's caster level for the purpose of determining its abilities and bonuses. This advancement grants the familiar increased hit points, attack bonuses, saving throws, and skill ranks, reflecting its heightened attunement to the arcanist's magical power.

Special: This feat is automatically granted to Sorcerers at 1st level, reflecting their innate magical affinity with their familiar. Wizards must select this feat at level 3 or later.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Improved Initiative
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: None.
Specifics: The character gains a +4 bonus to initiative checks.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Improved Knockdown
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite:  Int 13+, Knockdown, base attack bonus +6.
Specifics: A character with this feat counts as one size category larger when he makes a knockdown attack. All other knockdown conditions still apply.
Use: Selected. Monks receive this feat for free at level 6.

feats.name: Improved Parry
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Intelligence 13+.
Specifics: The character can parry more attacks per round than they are capable of making.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Improved Power Attack
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups)
Prerequisite: strength 13+, power attack

Specifics: This feat allows the character to trade a -4 penalty on his attack roll to gain a +6 bonus on his damage roll. It is very useful when fighting tough, easy-to-hit opponents. 

Use: combat mode

feats.name: Improved Sneak Attack I
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: rogue 6
Specifics: Add +1d6 to your sneak attack damage. This feat may be taken multiple times, to a maximum of +10d6.
Use: Automatic.

Prerequisite: Two-Weapon Fighting, Ambidexterity, base attack bonus +6 or higher, 17+ dexterity.
Specifics: The character with this feat is able to get a second off-hand attack (at a penalty of -5 to his attack roll).

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Improved Unarmed Strike
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General

Required for: Stunning Fist, Deflect Arrows.
Specifics: Armed opponents no longer get attacks of opportunity against the character when he attempts an unarmed attack.
Use: Automatic. Monks receive this feat for free at Level 1.

feats.description:

Prerequisite: charisma 15, 6 influence ranks, fighter 1

Specifics: Whenever you make a successful attack in combat, allies within 5m gain a +1 morale bonus to their attack bonuses for 1 round.

feats.description:

Specifics: The character's strong presence of mind gives him a +2 bonus to all Will saving throws.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Ironhide Resilience
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: Dex 13+, Con 13+, barbarian 3
Specifics: Allows you to use your constitution modifier in addition to your dexterity modifier for AC if using no armor. To a maximum of your level. This includes using any equipment with damage immunity to slashing, piercing, or bludgeoning.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Kal'ahn'dur’s Call
feats.description:
Type of feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: bard

Specifics: A solemn dwarven throat song, hummed on the frontline. Typically, a lone performer would initiate the song and be joined by others as the volume crescendos into a vibrant chorus. Grants friendly targets 5% physical DI per each 5 modified Perform ranks (To a maximum of 20%).

Use: selected.

feats.name: Keen Sense
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Race
Prerequisite: Elf.
Specifics: Characters with this feat may apply their full Search skill even when making a passive search.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Ki Cleave
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (granted based on class levels)
Prerequisite: monk 2
Specifics: The character with this ability can expend 1 point of Ki to gain the benefits of the Cleave feat for 1 hour. If the character already possesses the Cleave feat, they instead gain the benefits of the Great Cleave feat for 1 hour. This ability cannot be used while the character is wearing armor of any kind.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Ki Defense
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 1
Specifics: The character with this ability can expend 1 point of Ki to gain a bonus to AC equal to their Monk level. This effect lasts for 1 turn (10 rounds). This bonus does not function if the character is wearing armor of any kind, nor does it stack with the effects of the mage armor spell.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Ki Reflexes
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (granted based on class levels)
Prerequisite: monk 3
Specifics: The character with this ability can expend 1 point of Ki to gain the benefits of the Evasion, and Spring Attack feats for 1 hour. This ability cannot be used while the character is wearing armor of any kind.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Ki Strike +3
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Monk.
Specifics: The monk's unarmed attack counts as a magic weapon against creatures with damage reduction (+1 at 10th level, +2 at 13th, +3 at 16th).
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Knife Thrower
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: rogue 4
Specifics: +1 to attack rolls when using throwing knives or darts. The rogue has honed their skills with throwing knives, making them more effective with this weapon.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Knockdown
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: None.
Required for: Improved Knockdown.
Specifics: A character with this feat can attempt to knock his melee opponents to the ground. The character makes an attack roll at -4, and if successful the defender makes an opposed Discipline check against the character's attack roll. If the character wins, the defender is knocked to a prone position.
Use: Selected. Prone characters cannot attack. Characters receive a +4 bonus to attack prone opponents in melee, but a -4 penalty to attack them with a ranged weapon. A character can only make a Knockdown attempt on opponents that are one size category larger than himself, or smaller. The opponent gets a +4 bonus on his opposed check for every size category he is larger than the attacker, or a -4 penalty for every size category he is smaller. Monks receives this feat for free at level 6.

feats.name: Light Sensitivity
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Racial
Prerequisite: none
Specifics: A creature with this ability is dazzled (–1 penalty on attack rolls, Search checks, and Spot checks) in bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell. 

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Lightning Reflexes
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: None.
Specifics: The character's reflexes are faster than normal, granting him a +2 bonus to all Reflex saving throws.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Lilly's Alluring Lullaby
feats.description:
Type of feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: bard 3, curse song, 15 charisma

Specifics: A melody played with vibrato to mimic the vibration created by a siren's voice.

This piece gradually causes the listener to lose control of their body as it overwhelms the listener's mind—the effects worsen as the listener is unable to resist the song's allure. The DC decreases by 2 each round of the song. A successful Will save negates the effect.

- First round: The target's motor functions begin to slow, reducing their speed for 1d2 rounds.
- Second round: The song intensifies, causing the listener to enter a hypnotic trance, dazing them for 1d2 rounds.
- Third round: The song reaches its peak, and the listener is unable to focus on anything other than the melody, blinding them for 1 round. The target then loses full control of their body, falling prone for 1 round after the blinding effect ends.

If any of the saves are successful, the song ends.

The duration of the prone effect is extended by 1 round for every 5 ranks in Perform if played by a bard with Skill Focus: Perform.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Lingering Song
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Bard Song.
Specifics: The effects of the bard's songs will last an additional 5 rounds.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Linguist
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General (available every 3 level ups)
Prerequisite: only take this feat at 1st-level, 15+ Intelligence, 13+ Charisma
Specifics: You gain an additional 3 language points to use when creating your character.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Litany of the Faithful
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: can only take this feat as pure cleric 2nd-level
Specifics: This ability has two effects depending on the time of day. While it is day and you are outside, you may use two charges of Turn Undead to cast Bless centered on yourself; and while it is night and you are outside, you may use two charges of Turn Undead to cast Sanctuary on yourself. 

Use: selected.

feats.name: Lock Savant
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: rogue 4, intelligence 13+
Specifics: +2 Open Lock. This perk signifies a specialized knowledge in various locking mechanisms, making the rogue particularly adept at picking locks.

Additionally, can pick locks up to DC 35 without thieves tools.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Low-light Vision
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Race
Prerequisite: Elf, half-elf, or gnome.
Specifics: Low-light vision grants the ability to see in the dark, but not as far as darkvision.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Luck of Heroes
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general
Prerequisite: Can only take this at first level.
Specifics: The character gains a +1 bonus on all saving throws. 

Gives you a slightly increased chance to self-stabilize while bleeding out.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Luck of the Seas
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General (available every 3 level ups)
Prerequisite: 2 survival ranks
Specifics: This feat grants a +2 insight bonus to fishing checks.

Additionally, have a higher chance to get parts from a fish that require a percentile roll to succeed.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Lucky
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Race
Prerequisite: Halfling.
Specifics: This feat grants a +1 racial bonus to all saving throws.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Magical Fortitude
feats.description:
Type of feat: race

Specifics: Grants spell resistance equal to 11 + Class Levels

Use: automatic

feats.name: Manifest Adaptation
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: sorcerer 3
Specifics: The sorcerer is able to expend great effort to alter the spells that they are able to manifest.

Using this ability will open an interface allowing you to change sorcerer spells known. The cost to change spells is 24cxp + 12cxp per spell level.
 
Use: selected.

feats.name: Manifest Bloodline
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: sorcerer 1
Specifics: The sorcerer strains their body extensively, tapping within the source of their magical gift.

By draining their Constitution, the sorcerer awakens the magic coursing through their veins, gaining some Essence, a raw state of arcane magic, which can be weaved to restore depleted Spell slots. 
A spellcraft check is attempted, which determines how much Essence is gained. The sorcerer always regains at least half of their Sorcerer level in Essence.
A sorcerer may never have more than 10 unspent Essence at one time. All unspent Essence is lost when resting, as it loses its potency and fades away.

Additionally, sorcerers may use Charisma, OR Intelligence when dealing with spellcraft checks, whichever is higher.
 
Use: selected.

feats.name: Many-Faces
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: rogue 4, charisma 13+
Specifics: Once per day, this feat allows the rogue to create a disguise using the "Perform" skill without the need for a disguise kit. When employing this feat, the rogue is considered to have taken 20 on the Perform check to craft and maintain the disguise. This exceptional ability reflects the rogue's innate talent for convincingly altering their appearance and mannerisms.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Marathon Runner (E6)
feats.description:
Type of feat: epic (available via the E6 menu)
Prerequisite: Athetlic

Specifics: This feat gives you a 10% bonus to movement. 

Use: automatic

feats.name: Master Disguiser
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General (available every 3 level ups)
Prerequisite: 13+ Charisma
Specifics: You gain 2 additional disguise slots.

Additionally, you gain +2 to perform checks.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Master Grenadier
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General (available every 3 level ups)
Prerequisite: dexterity 15, intelligence 13

Specifics: Your expertise in handling and throwing volatile items makes your attacks far more effective. When using thrown items that require a saving throw, tanglefoot bags, flash powder, or any other throwable with a DC, you throw with such precision that your targets have a harder time avoiding the effects. The Difficulty Class (DC) for all your thrown items with saving throws increases by +2.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Masterful Crafter
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: 3rd level, natural crafter
Specifics: Character has increased chance to create a masterwork item.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Maximize Spell
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Metamagic
Prerequisite: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells.
Specifics: Maximized spells apply all variable numeric effects - including damage, number of targets, and so on - at their maximum values.
Use: A maximized spell occupies a spell slot two levels higher than normal. Saving throws and opposed rolls, such as those made when Dispel Magic is cast, are not affected.

feats.name: Melody Unbound (E6)
feats.description:
Type of feat: epic (available via the E6 menu)
Prerequisite: Bard 5
Specifics: You gain 1 extra level 2 bard spell slot.

Use: automatic

feats.name: Mistwood's Maddening Tune
feats.description:
Type of feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: bard, curse song

Specifics: An extravagant piece said to have been written by feys to defend their groves from intruders, inducing a maddening pain as the performer holds the final vibrato. The bard targets a single creature and makes a Perform Check. The target suffers Xd6 points of damage, where X is equal to their result divided by 10. The target is allowed a Listen Check to negate the damage as they manage to cover their ears. Does not affect deafened creatures.

Additionally, if played on the Harp, a successful Listen Check only halves the damage.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Mobility
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Dex 13+, Dodge.
Required for: Spring Attack.
Specifics: A character with this feat has learned to avoid attacks of opportunity more effectively, gaining a +4 dodge bonus to AC against them.
Use: Automatic, though a condition that negates a Dexterity bonus to AC also negates any dodge bonuses. Multiple dodge bonuses (from different feats or racial bonuses) are cumulative.

feats.name: Monk AC Bonus
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Monk level 1.
Specifics: Monks add their Wisdom modifier to their Armor Class, to a maximum of your level. This additional AC is nullified if the monk wears armor, shields, or any equipment that provides a damage immunity to physical damage types.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Monk Path
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: Monk 2
Specifics: The monk is able to diverge into a path of training, to specialize and hone their skills.

Use: Many.

feats.name: Monk Speed
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Monk level 3.
Specifics: Monks move more quickly than other classes, and this ability improves with experience.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Monster Uncanny Reflex
feats.description: The monster cannot be caught flat footed for any reason.

feats.name: Natural Crafter
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Can only take this feat at 1st-level.
Required for: masterful crafter
Specifics: Character is able to gain an additional 8 Craft XP per day.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Natural Mason
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General (available every 3 level ups)
Prerequisite: 6 knowledge: architecture ranks
Specifics: This feat grants a +2 insight bonus to knowledge: architecture checks.

Additionally, for every 4 BP you apply to a Build Request, an additonal BP will be applied to the BR (where possible).

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Nature Sense
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Druid level 1.
Specifics: The druid gains a +2 bonus on all attack rolls made while fighting in wilderness areas.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Nature's Companion
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: charisma 13+, ranger 1, druid 1
Specifics: A character with this feat is adept at bonding with creatures, gaining a +3 animal empathy bonus to animal empathy checks while they do not have an animal companion.

Additionally, a ranger with this feat is able to bond with a creature that is equal to their ranger levels in hit dice, instead of half their ranger levels rounded down.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Offensive Training vs Humans
feats.description:
Type of feat: race
Prerequisite: half-orc, orc

Specifics: This feat grants a +1 attack bonus against all humans.

Use: automatic

feats.name: Opportunist
feats.description:

Specifics: The rogue gains a +4 competence bonus to attack rolls when making attacks of opportunity.
Use: Automatic.

Use: automatic.
