feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: rogue 4, dexterity 15+
Specifics: Exceptional skills in pickpocketing. Gain a +2 bonus on Pickpocket checks specifically for pickpocketing.

Additionally, the rogue is no longer limited to 1/day use of `!steal`

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Point Blank Shot
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: None.
Required for: Rapid Shot.
Specifics: A character with this feat negates the -4 penalty for using missile weapons in melee, and gains an additional +1 to attack and damage with ranged weapons when the target is within 15 feet.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Power Attack
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups)
Prerequisite: strength 13+
Required for: cleave, improved power attack, great cleave, divine might

Specifics: A character with this feat can make powerful but ungainly attacks. When power attack is selected, it grants a +3 bonus to the damage roll, but at the cost of -2 to the attack roll. 

Use: combat mode

feats.name: Primevale Bond
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: wisdom 13+, ranger 2
Specifics: The ranger attunes themselves to the traditions and rituals of the old world, strengthening their bond with nature and what it stands for. The ranger gains an additional 1st level spell slot, this spell slot allows the ranger to cast spells earlier in their career if taken before the 4th level.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Proficient Gemhound
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General (available every 3 level ups)
Prerequisite: 13 Charisma
Specifics: When you use a chisel to collect crystals (gems), you will collect the materials at a faster rate, and have a small chance to get more out of the lattice than you might otherwise have gotten.

Additionally, as you are familiar with beauty, you are more likely to locate gems when prospecting a mining node.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Proficient Lumberjack
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General (available every 3 level ups)
Prerequisite: 13 Constitution
Specifics: You gain proficiency with handaxes and greataxes for the purposes of chopping trees. When you use a woodaxe or lumberjack's axe, when determining the amount of wood received from felling a tree, you will roll twice and use the higher number.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Proficient Miner
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General (available every 3 level ups)
Prerequisite: 13 Strength
Specifics: You gain proficiency with light and heavy picks for the purposes of mining. When you use a pick to mine, you will collect the materials at a faster rate, and have a small chance to get more out of the vein than you might otherwise have gotten.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Pulse of the Grove
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Druid 5, 15+ Wis
Specifics: Twice per day, if outdoors in a natural environment, the druid may channel the life-giving essence of the grove. While the druid remains stationary and continues to channel, all allies within 5 meters regain 1 hit point at the start of each of the druid’s turns. This channel may be maintained for a maximum of 2 minutes (20 rounds), restoring up to 20 hit points per creature. If the druid moves or is interrupted, the channel ends immediately.
Use: Selected

feats.name: Purity of Body
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Monk level 5.
Specifics: The monk is immune to all non-magical diseases.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Quick To Master
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Race
Prerequisite: Human.
Specifics: Humans start with an extra feat at character generation.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Quicken Spell
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Metamagic
Prerequisite: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells.
Specifics: Quickened spells can be cast instantaneously, making them invulnerable to counterspells or interruption. A quickened spell is cast as a free action, and another action can be attempted within the same round, including the casting of another spell. Only one quickened spell can be cast per round.
Use: Quickened spells occupy spell slots two levels higher than normal.

feats.name: Rapid Reload
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Base attack bonus +2.
Specifics: The character is able to reload so quickly that they get the same number of attacks with any crossbow as they would if they were using a normal bow.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Rapid Shot
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Dex 13+, Point Blank Shot.
Specifics: A character with this feat gains an extra attack per round with a ranged weapon (excluding crossbows). When a Rapid Shot is attempted, the extra attack is made at the character's highest base attack bonus, but all attacks within the round suffer a -2 penalty.
Use: Selected.

feats.name: Relentless Dispelling
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 4, charisma 14+

Specifics: You gain access to the "Dispel Magic" spell at-will.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Requiem for the Wode
feats.description:
Type of feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: bard

Specifics: A sinister dirge lifting the veil between the world of the living and the dead. As long as the song is active, Echoes of the Past are lured to the Bard like a moth to a flame. Bound echoes may not always be under the Bard's control. The Bard must concentrate and remain immobile for the duration of the performance.

Additionally, using this song over and over may have lingering effects on the Bard.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Resist Acid Energy
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Fort save bonus +8.
Specifics: Character gains +5 resistance against the chosen type of energy (first 5 points of damage of this type of energy is ignored).
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Resonant Spellsong
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: bard 1, sorcerer 1, spellcraft 4, perform 4

Specifics: When you use Saltborne Sonata (bard song), you gain 1d3 essence for your sorcerer channel bloodline abilities.

Use: passive.

feats.name: Rogue Dash
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: rogue 4, constitution 13+
Specifics: Twice per day, you can activate this feat to increase your movement speed by 50% for a duration of 2 rounds plus your Constitution modifier. This ability does not stack with effects that grant haste; if you are already under the effect of a haste spell or similar ability, activating this feat has no effect.

Additionally, while under the effects of the Rogue Dash, you gain the effects of the feat Spring Attack

Use: selected.

feats.name: Sacred Purification
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: can only take this feat as pure cleric 2nd-level
Specifics: The character may spend three of their turn undead attempts to create a pulse of positive energy. Up to 6 allies within 30 feet heal an amount of damage equal to 1d4 points + Charisma bonus, prioritizing allies with the lowest percentage of HP remaining. 

Use: selected.

feats.name: Sacred Ward
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: can only take this feat as pure cleric 3rd-level
Specifics: Tracing a divine script with positive energy, you can expend two charges of Turn Undead to place a glyph of warding effect on the ground.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Saltborne's Sonata
feats.description:
Type of feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: bard

Specifics: Often taught to minstrels and troubadours, this composition is common throughout Narumer and is suitable for many different instruments. Additional effects are granted to the default song according to which instrument it is played on. (All other bard songs use the charges from this feat to be cast.)

Provides all non-enemies within 30ft of the bard, +1 AB and +1 Damage.

Additionally, there are situational bonuses based on which instrument (or lack thereof) you are holding when you start the song.

Use: selected

feats.name: Scarred Monk Path - Initiation
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 2, 15 constitution
Specifics: The monk channels their passive ki into their scars, hardening them like leather. They gain 10% damage immunity against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. This effect only functions as long as the monk is not wearing armor of any kind.

Additionally, You can activate this ability spend 2 Ki to harden your body, any attack that connects with your body in melee will cause your attacker 1 bludgeoning damage, this effect lasts for a number of turns equal to your monk level.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Scarred Monk Path - Mastery
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 6, scarred monk path - proficiency, 15 constitution
Specifics: The monk has mastered the art of channeling passive ki into their scars, hardening them into superb armor. They gain 40% damage immunity against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. This ability replaces any previous bonuses from the scarred monk path and only functions as long as the monk is not wearing armor of any kind.

Additionally, You can activate this ability spend 2 Ki to harden your body, any attack that connects with your body in melee will cause your attacker 3 bludgeoning damage, this effect lasts for a number of turns equal to your monk level.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Scarred Monk Path - Proficiency
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 4, scarred monk path - initiation, 15 constitution
Specifics: The monk has become proficient in channeling passive ki into their scars, hardening them to the strength of armor. They gain 20% damage immunity against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. This ability replaces any previous bonuses from the scarred monk path and only functions as long as the monk is not wearing armor of any kind.

Additionally, You can activate this ability spend 2 Ki to harden your body, any attack that connects with your body in melee will cause your attacker 2 bludgeoning damage, this effect lasts for a number of turns equal to your monk level.

Use: selected.

feats.name: See the Unseen
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 2, charisma 12+

Specifics: You may cast "See Invisibilty" on yourself at-will.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Self-Repair (E6)
feats.description:
Type of feat: epic (available via the E6 menu)

Specifics: You have become exceptionally good at dealing with physical trauma on your own body.

You heal 1 hit point every 2 minutes, passively.

Use: automatic

feats.name: Shadowmelder
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: rogue 4
Specifics: This feat grants a +2 bonus to Hide and Move Silently checks, but only in specific environmental conditions. The bonus applies when the rogue is outdoors at night, or when in underground or cave environments where natural light is scarce or absent. This bonus reflects the rogue's specialized training and innate skill in utilizing darkness and shadows to their advantage in these specific settings.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Sharpshooter
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: weapon focus (heavy crossbow) or weapon focus (light crossbow), 3 spot, 13 wisdom, minimum character level 3

Specifics: A character with this feat is particularly skilled with crossbows, and gains a further +1 bonus to attack rolls made while using crossbows.

Use: passive.

feats.name: Silent Spell
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Metamagic
Prerequisite: Ability to cast 0-level spells.
Specifics: Silent spells are cast without a verbal component.
Use: A silenced spell occupies a spell slot of the same level as normal.

feats.name: Skaald's Rage
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: charisma 13, bard 1, barbarian 1, perform 4

Specifics: When using this ability you are able to transfer a charge from your "Saltborne Sonata" (bard song), to your Barbarian Rage if your Barbarian Rage pool is below max. 

Use: selected.

feats.name: Skill Affinity
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Racial (given based on race)
Prerequisite: Racial Specific
Specifics: These are racial specific feats that are given based on whatever race you pick up.

Use: Varies.

feats.description:

Prerequisite: Able to use the skill.
Specifics: A character with this feat is adept at a certain skill, gaining a +3 bonus on all checks with it.
Use: Automatic. This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not stack. It applies to a different skill in each case.

feats.name: Stage Combatant
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: bard 1, rogue 1, perform 4

Specifics: You are trained in using your flair and agility in battle.

You may use this ability to use one of your bard song charges, to target an enemy, if the enemy fails a fortitude saving throw, they will become blinded for 1d3 rounds.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Star Crossed Blessings
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: can only take this feat as pure cleric 2nd-level, requires knowledge, magic, night & stars, trickery, or illusion domains
Specifics: When wearing medium armor (or less) and no shield, you may expend two uses of turn undead to gain a mirror image duplicate (as the spell) for 1 turn per level. At level 5 this increases to two duplicates per use.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Stealthy
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: None.
Specifics: Character gains a +2 bonus on Hide and Move Silently checks.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Still Mind
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Monk level 3.
Specifics: The monk gains a +2 competence bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Still Spell
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Metamagic
Prerequisite: Ability to cast 1-level spells.
Specifics: Still spells are cast without a somatic component. Any penalties incurred from casting in armor do not apply to a spell prepared with this feat.
Use: A stilled spell occupies a spell slot one level higher than normal.

feats.name: Stonecunning
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Race
Prerequisite: Dwarf.
Specifics: This feat grants a +2 bonus on Search checks made in interior areas.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Stony Grasp
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 3, charisma 13+
Specifics: Allows you attempt to use stone and mud to entangle a given creature, reflex save to avoid.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Stormspeaker Monk Path - Initiation
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 2, dexterity 15
Specifics: A Stormspeaker Monk learns to harness the power of wind and lightning:

- They gain a +10% movement speed increase, as if they were a Monk three levels higher.
- They gain damage resistance 1/electricity due to their attunement to storms.
- The winds assist them in climbing and jumping, granting a +1 bonus on Climb and Jump checks.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Stormspeaker Monk Path - Mastery
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 6, stormspeaker monk path - proficiency, dexterity 15
Specifics: A Stormspeaker Monk further channels the essence of storms into their body and strikes:

- Their melee strikes (while wearing gloves) and thrown weapon attacks deal an additional +1 sonic damage, in addition to the existing +1 electricity damage.
- The winds now provide exceptional assistance, granting a +4 bonus on Climb and Jump checks.

These abilities replace the bonuses granted by the previous Stormspeaker Monk path feats.

Call the Storm: The monk may unleash their ki in a powerful burst of wind, casting gust of wind centered on themselves, as if cast by a druid of their Monk level. This ability costs 3 ki to activate.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Stormspeaker Monk Path - Proficiency
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 4, stormspeaker monk path - initiation, dexterity 15
Specifics: A Stormspeaker Monk, attuned to the fury of the storm, gains the following abilities:

- Their melee strikes (while wearing gloves) and thrown weapon attacks deal an additional +1 electricity damage.
- They gain a +1 bonus to Discipline checks per Monk level.
- The winds now assist them more effectively, granting a +2 bonus on Climb and Jump checks.

These abilities replace the bonuses granted by the previous Stormspeaker Monk path feat.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Strong Soul
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: only take this feat at 1st-level.
Specifics: The character gains a +1 bonus to fortitude and will saving throws, as well as a +1 bonus to any saving throw versus death magic. 

Additionally, you no longer suffer from Near Death Experience after being knocked unconscious.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Sudden Swarm
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 3, charisma 13+
Specifics: Modifies your Eldritch Blast, so that any creatures killed by eldritch blast create 1d3 spiders loyal to the warlock for 1 turn.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Summon Entity
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 2, charisma 12+
Specifics: Allows you to cast "Summon Creature I" at-will.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Summon Familiar
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Wizard, Warlock or sorcerer level 1.
Specifics: A character with this feat may summon a familiar. If the familiar dies, the character suffers 1d6 damage.
Use: Selected.

feats.name: Summoner's Yoke
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: can only take this feat as pure cleric 2nd-level
Specifics: You may expend a use of turn undead to cast cure light wounds on a summoned creature, animal companion or henchmen (includes pets).

Use: selected.

feats.name: Sun Soul Monk Path - Initiation
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 2
Specifics: A Sun Soul Monk learns to channel their fiery passive ki into their unarmed attacks and body:

- Their unarmed strikes deal an additional +1 fire damage, while wearing gloves.
- They gain resistance to cold damage 1/– due to mastery over their body heat.

Inner Fire: The monk may expel their ki as a fiery explosion, dealing fire damage as though casting egan's fiery burst as a sorcerer of their Monk level. This effect costs 1 ki to activate.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Sun Soul Monk Path - Mastery
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 6, sun soul monk path - proficiency
Specifics: A Sun Soul Monk has mastered the art of channeling their fiery passive ki:

- Their unarmed strikes now deal an additional +3 fire damage, while wearing gloves.
- They gain resistance to cold damage 3/– due to enhanced mastery over their body heat.

These abilities replace the bonuses granted by the previous Sun Soul Monk path feats.

Sunbolt Strike: The monk may unleash their ki in a fiery blast, dealing fire damage as though casting Aganazzar's Scorcher as a sorcerer of their Monk level. This ability costs 3 ki to activate.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Sun Soul Monk Path - Proficiency
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 4, sun soul monk path - initiation
Specifics: A Sun Soul Monk has refined their control over their fiery passive ki:

- Their unarmed strikes now deal an additional +2 fire damage, while wearing gloves.
- They gain resistance to cold damage 2/– due to further mastery over their body heat.

These abilities replace the bonuses granted by the previous Sun Soul Monk path feat.

Fiery Soul: The monk may expel their ki as a fiery attack, dealing fire damage on a single target as though casting combust as a sorcerer of their Monk level. This effect costs 2 ki to activate.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Swashbuckler
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: rogue 4, dexterity 13+, strength 13+
Specifics: If you are engaged in melee combat, you can apply your Sneak Attack bonus damage as though the opponent were flat-footed or you were flanking them. (They will not be flat-footed, or flanked, for any other purpose.)

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Thug
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: None.
Specifics: Character gains a +2 bonus on Initiative checks and a +2 bonus on Influence checks.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Toughness
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: None.
Specifics: A character with this feat is tougher than normal, gaining one bonus hit point per level. Hit points are gained retroactively when choosing this feat.

Additionally, after resting, you will be given +1 temporary hit point per level.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Trackless Step
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: ranger 1, druid 3
Specifics: This feat grants a +2 competence bonus to hide and move silently checks when in wilderness areas.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Turn Undead
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Class
Prerequisite: Cleric level 1 or Paladin level 2.
Required for: Divine Might and Divine Shield.
Specifics: With this feat, the character can force undead to flee in terror. This ability may be activated three times per day, plus the cleric's Charisma modifier. The cleric's level and Charisma are used to determine how many undead are turned.
Use: Selected. If the cleric has twice as many levels as the undead have Hit Die, the undead are instantly destroyed.

feats.name: Twin Fangs Path - Initiation
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 2, 13 dexterity
Specifics: The monk embraces the art of dual-bladed combat and venomous strikes:

- Their strikes with knives (dagger, kukri, assassin dagger) now deal an additional +1 poison damage.
- The monk gains the effects of the Use Poison feat, allowing them to safely apply and use poisons without risking accidental exposure.
- Double Dip: When poisoning a knife (dagger, kukri, assassin dagger), the monk can coat both of their equipped blades with a single dose of poison, conserving their resources.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Twin Fangs Path - Mastery
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 6, twin fangs path - proficiency, 13 dexterity
Specifics: The monk's expertise in venom and swift strikes reaches new heights:

- The monk becomes completely immune to all poisons, both natural and magical.
- Krait's Embrace: By spending 2 Ki points, the monk may gain a bonus feat of Two-Weapon Fighting for 1 turn (10 rounds). If the character already possesses the Two-Weapon Fighting feat, they instead gain the benefits of the Improved Two-Weapon Fighting feat for 1 turn (10 rounds). This ability cannot be used while the character is wearing armor of any kind.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Twin Fangs Path - Proficiency
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 4, twin fangs path - initiation, 13 dexterity
Specifics: The monk refines their mastery over dual-bladed combat and venomous techniques:

- Their strikes with knives (dagger, kukri, assassin dagger) now deal +2 poison damage.
- Monk's Hood Extract: By spending 4 Ki points, the monk may coat their knives with a special substance. This imbues their weapons with the following property:
  - On Hit: Wounding

This ability applies only to knives wielded by the monk and lasts for a number of rounds equal to your monk level.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups)
Prerequisite: dexterity 15+
Required for: improved two-weapon fighting

Specifics: A character with this feat reduces the penalties suffered when fighting with two weapons. The normal penalty of -4 to the primary hand and -8 to the off-hand becomes -2 for the primary hand and -6 for the off-hand. The ambidexterity feat further reduces the attack penalty for the second weapon by 4 (to -2/-2). Best results are achieved if the off-hand weapon is light, further reducing the penalty for both the primary and off-hand by 2 (to 0/0). 

Use: automatic

feats.name: Ulrin's War Song
feats.description:
Type of feat: class (given based on class levels)
Prerequisite: bard, 15 strength

Specifics: A melody played to infuse the muscles of those who hear it, granting increased strength.

When played, those who hear it gain a +2 strength bonus until the end of the duration of the song (does not stack with itself).

Use: selected.

feats.name: Umbral Curse
feats.description:
Type of feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: warlock 1, rogue 1, dexterity 15

Specifics: You have learned how to adapt your magic to take advantage of the weak spots you notice.

You may deliver a sneak attack with your eldritch blast if your target is flat-footed or flanked. This deals sneak attack dice as if it were a melee or ranged weapon.

Use: passive.

feats.name: Underground Medic
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: rogue 4, 2 ranks in heal
Specifics: You are knowledgeable in treating wounds and illnesses with limited resources. You gain a +2 bonus on Heal checks, and if your dexterity modifier is higher than your wisdom modifier, use your dexterity modifier for all heal checks.

Additionally, your successful heal checks using bandages or kits restores one extra hit point.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Unrefined Palate
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Special
Prerequisite: halforc, orc, e6

Specifics: This feat allows the character to consume spoiled food, or raw meat. All sources of food, including spoiled food, are worth a minimum of 5% hunger.

Additionally, you do not risk getting disease from nearly spoiled food.

Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Use Poison
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: dexterity 13+
Specifics: The character is trained in the use of poison and never has to make a dexterity check when applying poison to a non-bludgeoning melee weapon or ammunition.

Additionally, When applying ingestible poisons to food, or attacking someone with a poisoned weapon, the DC of the poison is 2 higher.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Verdant Awakening (E6)
feats.description:
Type of feat: epic (available via the E6 menu)
Prerequisite: Druid 3
Specifics: You gain 1 extra level 3 druid spell slot.

Use: automatic

feats.name: Vermin Heart
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general (available every three level-ups) 
Prerequisite: 4 ranks animal empathy
Specifics: Expand your abilities in Animal Empathy to encompass Vermin creatures. You gain the capability to communicate and empathize with Vermin using your natural affinity for understanding animals. Moreover, if you possess the Animal Companion ability, you can form a bond with a Vermin creature as if it were an animal.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Vermin Shape
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class
Prerequisite: druid 5, vermin heart
Specifics: The character with this ability can take the shape of a vermin at will. It may be used twice per day. The transformation has a duration of 1 hour per class level.

Shapes available: giant wasp, giant scorpion, beetle slicer, large spider, scarab

Use: selected.

feats.name: Vermin Shape (Minor)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class
Prerequisite: druid 3, vermin heart
Specifics: The character with this ability can take the shape of a minor vermin at will. It may be used once per day. The transformation has a duration of 1 hour per class level.

Shapes available: beetle, spider, scorpion, fly, crab

Use: selected.

feats.name: Voidsense
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 2, charisma 12+
Specifics: Gives you blindsight up to 10ft.

Use: automatic.

feats.name: Walk Unseen
feats.description:
Type of feat: invocation
Prerequisite: warlock 4, charisma 14+

Specifics: You may cast "Invisibility" on yourself at-will, you will remain invisible for a number of rounds equal to your warlock level.

Use: selected.

feats.name: Way of the Shadows Path - Initiation
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 2, hide 5, move silently 5
Specifics: The monk has begun to channel their ki from the shadows, shrouding themselves in supernatural darkness. By spending a point of ki, the monk gains 10% concealment for 1 turn (10 rounds).

Use: selected.

feats.name: Way of the Shadows Path - Mastery
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 6, way of the shadows path - proficiency, hide 9, move silently 9
Specifics: The monk has mastered channeling their ki from the shadows, shrouding themselves in supernatural darkness. By spending a point of ki, the monk may cast darkness (as per the spell, caster level equal to their Monk level) centered on themselves and gain 40% concealment for 1 turn (10 rounds).

Use: selected.

feats_all.name: Way of the Shadows Path - Proficiency

feats.name: Way of the Shadows Path - Proficiency
feats.description:
Type of Feat: class (given based on class levels) 
Prerequisite: monk 4, way of the shadows path - initiation, hide 7, move silently 7
Specifics: The monk has become proficient in channeling their ki from the shadows, shrouding themselves in supernatural darkness. By spending a point of ki, the monk may cast darkness (as per the spell, caster level equal to their Monk level) centered on themselves and gain 20% concealment for 1 turn (10 rounds).

Use: selected.

feats_all.name: Way of the Shadows Path - Initiation

feats.name: Weapon Finesse
feats.description:
Type of Feat: general
Prerequisite: none
Specifics: A character with this feat is adept at using light weapons subtly and effectively, allowing him to make melee attack rolls with his dexterity modifier instead of strength (if his dexterity is higher than his strength). 

Use: Automatic when using any light weapon.

feats.name: Weapon Focus
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Proficiency with the chosen weapon type, base attack bonus +1 or higher.
Required for: Weapon Specialization (fighter only).
Specifics: A character with this feat is particularly skilled with a specific weapon, gaining a +1 attack bonus with it.
Use: Automatic. This feat may be selected multiple times, but the effects do not stack. It applies to a new weapon in each case.
Special: Halflings and gnomes are Small creatures and as such they can never use the following large weapons: dire mace, double-bladed sword, double axe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, and scythe.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (Elf)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Race
Prerequisite: Elf.
Specifics: This feat allows the character to use the longsword, rapier, longbow, and shortbow.
Normal: A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.
Use: All elves start with this feat but can gain other weapon proficiencies as well.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (bard)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Special
Prerequisite: Bard level 1.
Specifics: This feat allows the character to use the longsword, rapier, sap, short sword, shortbow, and whip.
Normal: A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.
Use: All bards start with this feat but can gain other weapon proficiencies as well.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (druid)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Special
Prerequisite: Druid Level 1.
Specifics: This feat allows the character to use the club, dagger, scimitar, sickle, spear, quarterstaff, dart, and sling.
Normal: A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.
Use: All druids start with this feat and cannot gain weapon proficiency with any other weapons.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (dwarf)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Special
Prerequisite: Dwarf, weapon proficiency (martial)
Specifics: This feat allows the character to use the dwarven waraxe.
Normal: A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.
Use: Dwarves get this feat for free if they have weapon proficiency (martial).

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (exotic)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: Base attack bonus +1 or higher.
Specifics: This feat allows effective use of all exotic weapons. The exotic weapons list includes the bastard sword, dire mace, dwarven waraxe, double axe, kama, katana, kukri, scythe, shuriken, whip, and two-bladed sword.
Normal: A character cannot equip weapons they are not proficient in.
Use: Automatic.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (martial)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: None.
Specifics: This feat allows effective use of all martial weapons. The martial weapons list includes the battleaxe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, handaxe, heavy flail, light flail, light hammer, longbow, longsword, rapier, scimitar, short sword, shortbow, throwing axe, trident and warhammer.
Normal: A character cannot equip weapons they are not proficient in.
Use: Barbarians, fighters, paladins, and rangers are automatically proficient with all martial weapons.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (monk)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Special
Prerequisite: Monk level 1.
Specifics: This feat allows effective use of club, dagger, handaxe, light crossbow, heavy crossbow, quarterstaff, shuriken, kama, katar, wind fire wheel, claws, sai, nunchaku, katana, darts, and sling.

Normal: A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.

Use: All monks start with this feat but can gain other weapon proficiencies as well.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (orc)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Special
Prerequisite: halforc, orc
Specifics: This feat allows the character to use the handaxe, battleaxe, or greataxe.

Additionally, if they have martial weapon proficiency, they are considered proficient with the double-sided axe.

Normal: A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.
Use: All halforcs start with this feat but can gain other weapon proficiencies as well.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (orc)
feats.description:

Normal: A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.
Use: All halforcs start with this feat but can gain other weapon proficiencies as well.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (rogue)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: Special
Prerequisite: Rogue level 1.
Specifics: This feat allows the character to use the club, dagger, dart, handaxe, light crossbow, heavy crossbow, quarterstaff, mace, short sword, rapier, shortbow, morningstar, and sling.
Normal: A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.
Use: All rogues start with this feat but can gain other weapon proficiencies as well.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (simple)
feats.description:
Type of Feat: General
Prerequisite: None.
Specifics: This feat allows effective use of all simple weapons, including the club, dagger, mace, sickle, spear, morningstar, quarterstaff, light and heavy crossbows, dart, and sling.
Normal: A character cannot equip weapons they are not proficient in.
Use: All characters except for druids, monks, rogues, and wizards are automatically proficient with all simple weapons. The spell Tenser's Transformation gives a wizard a temporary proficiency with all simple weapons.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (wizard)
